$Comment: Wear the whole Harvest Set: the Harvest Hat, Tunic (or the Great Turkey Mantle in its place), Gloves and Trousers.
GEAR_SET_TIER counts a set's bonus tier coming on as gear goes on, its amount the number of pieces
that tier takes, so Amount 4 is met the moment the set's four-piece tier
(GearSets/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Harvest_Set.json) comes on. Logging in already dressed counts
nothing: the pieces have to go on.
Earned once and kept. The set carries from one feast to the next, so this file has no Parent: the
yearly skeleton would ask for the same clothes every year. It carries no full_table tag, so The Full
Table never waits on it. It pays nothing but its points. The criterion's TextKey words the step from
this pack's own lang file. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id harvest_feast_harvest_set.
